project_title: Machine Learning Enhanced Graph-Based Anomaly Detection for Financial Transactions
cohort: Reuse all six fixed Phase5G held-out accounts, no outcome selection or additions

matching.count_and_evidence_fraction: exact; same account and historical incident denominator
matching.selection: Enumerate all count-matched subsets under the bound; filter all budgets and both monetary calipers; order by SHA256(seed, context, structured identity, control IDs); select first two distinct sets
matching.insufficient_controls: unmatched; no tolerance relaxation or single-control substitution
matching.context: Identical history hash, cutoff, time kind, population, account, model and canonical19 schema

ranking.justification: Unit coefficient in the same raw anomaly-score units; one unit of excess response contributes one unit to score; fixed mechanistic hypothesis, no empirical optimality claim
ranking.family_excess: median matched structured raw deltas minus median of their pooled controls (exactly two per structured omission)
ranking.aggregation: equal mean across families with at least one fully matched structured omission
ranking.missing: raw E4 fallback with explicit reason
ranking.tie_break: descending unrounded score then ascending account ID
ranking.numerics: float64 finite checks; no clipping or calibration; fail on overflow or absorbed nonzero addition

reuse: Checksum-verified Phase5G vectors by history-aware focal omission identity; exact batch versus singleton frozen E4 scoring verification
reference_checks: First new control per score stratum against full reference and an uncached focal replay; no approximation
labels: No evaluation-label parsing, fitting, control selection or detector metrics; protected bytes may be hashed
outputs: Exclusive new data/results/v2/phase5h-* directory; manifest last; preserve incomplete runs
projection_policy: Separate incremental reuse cost from cold unique-scenario cost; same-5K-cost scenarios for 250,500,1500,14998 accounts only; 50K unprofiled and guarded
